title: F16 · new_city · Room 304
lines: And nobody to tell when you get home safe.
She eats standing up, because sitting at a table for one feels worse.
At home right now, six people are fighting over one remote.
She walked down for tea, just to hear a voice.
The chai seller had a blue-grey face in the kettle's steam. He did not ask her name.
The one who is sent far from the celebration is the one holding the world level.
Her mother picked up before the first ring finished.
Far is not the same as alone. That is sadhana.
